title: UNDER ARMOUR OPENS FIRST MONTANA STORE, INTRODUCES NEW RETAIL CONCEPT IN BOZEMAN
summary: Under Armour officially opened the doors to its first Montana retail location on September 18, welcoming customers and community members to the Bozeman Sports House at Gallatin Crossing.
body_markdown:
### Expanding Where Demand Already Exists


Despite having no physical retail presence in Montana, Under Armour had already seen meaningful e-commerce demand from consumers across the state. The new store builds on that established interest, bringing the brand closer to an existing consumer base through a physical retail experience.


Located just 1.5 miles from Montana State University, a longstanding Under Armour partner, the store also offers a natural connection to a passionate athletic community of students, athletes, alumni, and fans.


### A New Approach to Under Armour Retail


The Bozeman Sports House brings together experiences traditionally offered through separate retail formats.


Consumers entering the store are introduced to Under Armour's latest performance innovations and full-price product. As they move through the space, sport-driven storytelling and key product franchises reinforce the brand's performance heritage, while a broader assortment provides options across different needs and price points.


The approach allows Under Armour to introduce premium product to more consumers while maintaining accessibility, creating a model designed to support both brand elevation and commercial growth.
